sources: 2026 Castle Mountain / Johnston Canyon campground map PDF (Banff brochures page)
Esri World Imagery tiles (rendered and viewed) (z16-z17 here is a dark, snow-covered winter scene: the loop could not be made out)

values.note: A fire permit is extra: C$12.00 a day on the Banff list, C$17.00 on the Lake Louise area list; the fees page does not say which covers Castle Mountain.

fees.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/visit/tarifs-fees ('Castle Mountain - Unserviced with washroom building having toilets only $29.50'; 'Banff - Fire Permit, per day $12.00'; 'Lake Louise Area Campgrounds and Banff Icefields Parkway Campgrounds - Fire Permit, per day $17.00'; 'Online reservation $11.50'; page modified 2026-02-12), read 2026-11-10

values.note: Booked through the Parks Canada Reservation Service (online or 1-877-737-3783), until 2 pm on the day of arrival. Check-in 2-8 pm, check-out by 11 am. Six people per site. Generators 9-10:30 am and 5-7 pm.

booking.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping ('Maximum stay – 14 nights'; 'Check-in time: 2 p.m. to 8 p.m.'; 'Check-out or re-register by 11 a.m.'; 'Campground reservations may be made until 2 p.m. on date of booking'; generators '9 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. and 5 p.m. to 7 p.m.'; page modified 2026-09-15); 2026 table: Castle Mountain reservable June 18 to September 20, read 2026-11-10

hookups.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping (2026 table: Castle Mountain 'Unserviced'; services list has no electricity), read 2026-11-10

sites.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping ('Castle Mountain 42'; 'suitable for tents or small RVs up to 7.3 metres (24 feet)'); the 2026 campground map numbers sites 1-42, read 2026-11-10

facilities.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping (Castle Mountain services: 'Drinking water, Flush toilet, Cooking shelter, Picnic shelter, Firepits, Food storage locker'), read 2026-11-10

season.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/banff/activ/camping (2026 table: Castle Mountain operational dates June 18 to September 21; reservable to September 20), read 2026-11-10

note: In woods on the Bow Valley Parkway (Hwy 1A), 32 km from Banff; a small creek runs through the loop. Cook shelter and food lockers; every site has a firepit. No showers or dump station are listed. --Claude
summary: Keep. 42 sites (stored 43), RVs to 24 ft, 2026 dates June 18 - Sep 21 (reservable to Sep 20), C$29.50 plus fire permit; flush toilets and drinking water confirmed. Imagery too dark to check the pin.
flags: sites.count 43 -> 42: the 2026 camping page table and the 2026 campground map (sites 1-42) agree.
Season: stored closes 09-20 -> 09-21 (operational date); September 20 is the last reservable date and is written as booking.season.
Fire permit amount unclear: the fees page lists C$12 (Banff) and C$17 (Lake Louise area and Icefields Parkway campgrounds) without saying which list Castle Mountain is on; both are in fees.note.

PIN not verified: stored 51.26833,-115.91266. Esri imagery here rendered but is a dark winter scene under long shadows; a small clearing shows at the pin just north-east of the parkway, which matches the map (loop east of Hwy 1A), but the loop itself could not be seen. No move proposed.
PHONE: stored 1-877-737-3783 is the Parks Canada reservation line, the only number the pages give.
23-ft fit: the 24-ft limit passes; 'small RVs' wording, so pads may be tight.

Agency rows: the entry inherits the generic `federal` row's booking platform (recreation.gov), 180-day window and the US interagency senior/access discount; none applies to Parks Canada.
